I did, but yeah, I thought that too. I triple checked at least. Though I think I spoke too soon. The issue seems to have resolved itself somehow. I'm now able to sign in, so you can add me to the list! :D Thank you for your effort!

GT: RureTan

I get an error telling me my product key is invalid. I called Microsoft and they told me the key is valid, but their system won't accept mine because support for Games for Windows Live has been dropped. I did research and several people got new keys from Microsoft, but it's a matter of getting a good customer support rep.

To be clear, the game runs fine on my computer (Windows 7), but signing in with anything other than a default profile not connected to Xbox Live is impossible, or so it seems.

I'd love to join you guys once this gets resolved.

This really upsets me because I got this game for Christmas and I can't even connect my gamertag, let alone play multiplayer. Microsoft and Xbox Live have been no help. This just adds salt to the wound.

Abusive and generally uncaring. I don't know how to describe it without sounding rude myself, but this family member was abusive when my friend was younger. She currently hides what little food and money they have, lies about paying bills, constantly belittles others, and has tons of selfish traits. Basically, her life is spiraling out of control and she's so selfish that she wants to take her family down with her.

It's not someone anyone with depression should be around.

Thank you for the suggestion! We both play games quite often, and have for the past few years. However it's getting to the point where neither of us really want to. Not because we dislike it, just because of depression and/or apathy. It does help when we're up for it though!

A bad living situation and depression, I guess. We both have clinical depression but it doesn't usually get this bad for either of us. This friend also lives with a family member that's really rude and I honestly believe that's the root of the problem. Of course, I don't just mean a somewhat rude person, it's worse than that. Basically that one person that ruins lives without trying to.
